root_cause.finding: The V7.214 deferred account-ready queue had 149 pending login listeners at first-playable and drains one listener roughly every 45 ms after startup.
root_cause.defect: Its combat busy check uses window.__V7085_TOWER_FIGHTING__, but the current server-authoritative Tower replay never set that flag.
root_cause.effect: The queue therefore resumed draining through the first Tower combat, overlapping the replay with many startup callbacks/RPC completions/DOM work.
measured_evidence: Latest startup telemetry: queued=149, drained=0 at first-playable.
Latest first-floor Tower choose reported stalled_action at 6501 ms in replay phase.
A 781 ms long main-thread task was recorded on the Tower during the same startup window.
Earlier run recorded a 1873 ms long main-thread task and replay stalls.
root_cause.timing_match: 149 queued listeners × ~45 ms drain spacing is at least ~6.7 s of startup queue activity, matching the reported first-fight-only pause/stutter window.

change: Set window.__V7085_TOWER_FIGHTING__=true for the complete authoritative door + replay route.
Clear the compatibility flag in finally after the replay ends.
This makes the existing V7.214 startup queue defer its jobs during Tower combat instead of competing with replay timers.
